questions.question: If a² + b² + c² = ab + bc + ca, then the value of (11a⁴+13b⁴+15c⁴)/(16a²b²+19b²c²+17c²a²) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a2 + b2 + c2 = ab + bc + ca

**Concept used:**

If a2 + b2 + c2 = ab + bc + ca, a = b = c

**Calculation:**

⇒ (11a⁴+13b⁴+15c⁴)/(16a²b²+19b²c²+17c²a²)

Put a = b = c everywhere in the expression,

⇒ (11a⁴+13a⁴+15a⁴)/(16a²a²+19a²a²+17a²a²)

⇒ (39a⁴)/(52a⁴) = (39)/(52) = (3)/(4)

**∴ The correct answer is (3)/(4)**

questions.question: Find the length of a tangent drawn to a circle with radius 8 cm from a point 17 cm from the centre of the circle,
questions.solution:
**Given :**

The radius of the circle OA = 8 cm

Distance of the point from the center of the circle OP = 17 cm

**Concept Used :**

The tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact.

**Calculation :**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1edf658fc7b4f82ddf20c72f5d29bd958bad152eece7bbb0e2b2358cc524786.png] 

In right-angled Δ OAP using the Pythagorean theorem, OP² = OA² + PA²

⇒ 17² = 8² + PA²

⇒ 289 - 64 = PA²

⇒ 15² = PA²

⇒ 15 = PA

**∴ The length of tangent = 15 cm.**

questions.question: The average of 18 integers is found to be 41. It was detected that by mistake the integer 127 was copied as 341, while calculating the average. Then the correct average is:
questions.solution:
**Given :**

The average of 18 integers = 41

By mistake 127 was copied as 341

**Formula Used :**

Average = Sum of all values / Total no of values

**Calculation :**

Using formula, sum of integers = 18 × 41 = 738

Difference between actual value and copied value = 341 - 127 = 214

So, the actual sum = 738 - 214 = 524

Thus, the correct average = 524 / 18 = 29 (1)/(9)

**∴ The correct average of integers = 29 (1)/(9).**

questions.question: The lengths of the two sides of a triangle are 14 cm and 9 cm. Which of the options below can be the length of the third side?
questions.solution:
**Given :**

Two sides of a triangle are 14cm and 9 cm

**Concept used :**

To form a triangle,

(a) The sum of any two sides of a triangle will be greater than the third side of that triangle.

(b) The difference of any two sides of a triangle will be smaller than the third side of that triangle.

**Solution:**

Checking option (1):

Condition (1)

⇒14 + 9 > 17 ⇒ 23 > 17

⇒14 + 17 > 9 ⇒ 31 > 9

⇒17 + 9 > 14 ⇒ 26 > 14

Condition (2)

⇒14 - 9 ⇒17 - 14 

⇒17 - 9 

Both the conditions are satisfied.

Checking option (2):

14 + 9 > 23 ⇒ 23 = 23

Condition (1) is not satisfied.

Checking option (3):

24 - 9 ⇒ 14 = 14

Condition (2) is not satisfied.

Checking option (4):

9 + 5 > 14 ⇒ 14 = 14

Condition (1) is not satisfied.

**∴ The length of the third side is 17 cm.**

questions.question: The marked price of a school bag was Rs. 550. This price was 10% above the cost price. It was sold at a discount of 10% on the marked price. Find the gain or loss percentage.
questions.solution:
Given:

MP of a school bag = Rs. 550

MP = CP + CP × 10/100

Discount on MP = 10%

Formula used:

Loss % = ((CP - SP) / CP ) × 100

Calculations:

⇒ 550 = (100 + 10)/100 × CP

⇒ CP = 550 × 100 / 110 = Rs. 500

According to the given data,

⇒ SP = MP × ((100 - 10))/(100)

⇒ SP = 550 × (90)/(100) = Rs. 495

Now, Loss% = (500 - 495)/500 × 100

⇒ Loss% = 5/500 × 100 = 1

**∴ The loss percentage is 1%.**

questions.question: What is the present value of Rs. 9,360 at an interest rate 20% at the end of two years compounded annually?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Amount after 2 years = Rs. 9360

The rate = 20% . 

**Formula used:**

Amount ( A ) = Principal ( P ) × (1 + r / 100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

The present value is 9360 ( after 2 years ). In compound interest,

⇒ A= P × (1 + r / 100)n

⇒ 9360 = P × ( 1 + 20/100)²

⇒ 9360= P × 36/25 

⇒ P = 9360 × 25 / 36 = 6500 

**∴ The present value of Rs. 9,360 at an interest rate 20% at the end of two years compounded annually is 6500.**

questions.question: If a + b + c = 13 and ab + bc + ca = 45, find a² + b² + c².
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b + c = 13 and ab + bc + ca = 45

**Formula Used:**

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

**Calculation:**

According to the formula,

(a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 13² = a² + b² + c² + 2 × 45

⇒ a² + b² + c² = 169 - 90 = 79

**∴ The correct answer is option 1**

questions.question: The marked price of 85 items was equal to the cost price of 153 items. The selling price of 104 items was equal to the marked price of 65 items. Calculate the percentage profit or loss from the sale of each item.
questions.solution:
Given

The marked price of 85 items is the cost price of 153 items

The selling price of 104 items equals the marked price of 65 items

**Formula used:**

Profit percentage = (SP-CP)/(CP) × 100

Calculation

Let the marked price be M, the selling price be S, and the cost price be C.

⇒ MP × 85 = 153 × CP 

⇒ MP/CP = 153 / 85 = 9/5 

⇒ SP × 104 = MP × 65 

⇒ SP/MP = 65 /104 = 5/8 

Solving this we get the ratio = CP : SP : MP = 40:45:72

**∴ Profit percentage = (45-40)/(40)× 100 = 12.5% profit**

questions.question: The length, breath of a cuboidal box are 25 cm and 15 cm, respectively, If the volume of the box is 1875 cm³, then the height of the box (in cm) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length (l) of cuboidal box = 25 cm

Breadth (b) of cuboidal box = 15 cm

Volume of box = 1875 cm³

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height

**Calculation:**

Volume of the box = l × b × h

⇒ 1875 = 25 × 15 × h

⇒ h = 15 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 5 cm.**
